errors.title: Book writing records are not ready
errors.reason: The canonical Story System data required to continue writing is unavailable.
errors.impact: Writing may use outdated data or omit chapter requirements.
errors.next_action: Run `/webnovel-init` to create project records. If initialized, run `/webnovel-doctor` to find missing items.

errors.title: Writing checks failed
errors.reason: A prewrite, precommit, or postcommit check found a blocking issue.
errors.impact: This chapter cannot reliably proceed to the next step.
errors.next_action: Follow the impact and repair guidance, then rerun the same writing command.

errors.title: Chapter fact commit rejected
errors.reason: This chapter has uncovered nodes, unresolved ambiguities, or blocking review issues.
errors.impact: The chapter is not part of the canonical story; later chapters cannot rely on it.
errors.next_action: Resolve missed_nodes, pending, or blocking issues, then recommit the chapter facts.

errors.title: Incomplete intermediate result format
errors.reason: A check or data preparation result is missing required fields.
errors.impact: Chapter facts cannot be verified as complete, so committing cannot proceed.
errors.next_action: Rerun the step that generated this result. If it fails again, run `/webnovel-doctor` and include logs in your report.

errors.title: Missing intermediate result file
errors.reason: Writing checks, fulfillment results, or extracted story facts were not generated.
errors.impact: Chapter facts cannot be saved safely.
errors.next_action: Rerun the same main command to resume from the missing step.

errors.title: Story data update failed
errors.reason: Chapter facts were generated, but synchronization to state, summaries, memory, or retrieval failed.
errors.impact: Later queries may miss the latest chapter changes.
errors.next_action: Fix the failure and rerun the data update. Run `/webnovel-doctor` to locate the blocker.

errors.title: Story data update incomplete
errors.reason: Chapter fact synchronization is pending or lacks status records.
errors.impact: Queries may temporarily return incomplete data.
errors.next_action: Wait or rerun the update. Run `/webnovel-doctor` if this recurs.

errors.title: Retrieval temporarily degraded
errors.reason: Vector retrieval is unavailable or failed; a simpler retrieval method is being used.
errors.impact: The workflow can continue, but retrieved context may be less complete.
errors.next_action: No action is needed for this run. If frequent, check the RAG API key and network configuration.

fallback.title: Unregistered problem encountered
fallback.reason: The system encountered a problem that is not in its error catalog.
fallback.impact: The current operation is not considered complete.
fallback.next_action: Run `/webnovel-doctor`, or attach `.webnovel/logs/run_last.log` when reporting the issue.
